text:
maria: RFC — propose 'routing_shim' config: per-tier rules + fallback variants + soft quota behavior. Sketch below, looking for risks/ops pain.

alex: can you paste example schema?

maria: ```
{
  "tiers": {
    "free": { "preferred": ["gpt-small"], "fallback": ["gpt-tiny"], "soft_quota": {"token_limit": 10000, "enforcement": "delay"} },
    "pro": { "preferred": ["gpt-medium"], "fallback": ["gpt-small","gpt-tiny"], "soft_quota": {"token_limit": 100000, "enforcement": "throttle"} },
    "enterprise": { "preferred": ["gpt-large"], "fallback": ["gpt-medium"], "soft_quota": {"token_limit": 1000000, "enforcement": "none"} }
  },
  "region_overrides": { "eu": { "pro": { "preferred": ["gpt-medium-eu"] } } },
  "fallback_policy": { "max_latency_ms": 2000, "retry": 1 }
}
```

jon: broad q: how does "soft_quota.enforcement": "delay" vs "throttle" behave in runtime? need concrete semantics.

maria: good call — delay = add artificial per-request wait to shape qps; throttle = start returning 429-like soft responses with user-facing header suggesting upgrade. Both still allow fallback variant routing.

sophia: telemetry ask: we need per-tenant counters: tokens_charged, fallback_count, soft_quota_triggered, avg_fallback_latency. Also tie to rollout tags so we can A/B test enforcement rules.

maria: agree. plan is to tag every routed request with policy_id and tier, emit v2 telemetry events: routing.decision, routing.fallback, quota.soft_trigger.

ops-oncall: add an ops playbook for fallback storms — if fallback_count spike > X for tenant, auto-open incident and reduce fallback aggressiveness.

deploy-bot: preview deploy: routing-shim v0.1 deployed to staging :rocket: 

alex: UX question — console should let support team simulate a tenant against a policy and show sample routing trace. small modal with "simulate request" would save time.

maria: yep adding simulator to the rollout checklist. next steps: turn this issue into a RFC PR, wire telemetry events, mock up console simulator, and schedule canary for 10 enterprise tenants then widen. :thumbsup: 

sophia: :eyes: I'll draft dashboard tiles and alert thresholds.
